meta.name: add-dashboard
meta.description: Add a monitoring dashboard to NanoClaw. Installs @nanoco/nanoclaw-dashboard and a pusher that sends periodic JSON snapshots.

copy.tagline: 为 NanoClaw 添加监控仪表盘并推送数据快照
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在使用 NanoClaw 并需要可视化运行状态
copy.tagline_en: Add a monitoring dashboard and push data snapshots to NanoClaw
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you use NanoClaw and need to visualize its runtime status

howto.what: Claude 会给 NanoClaw 安装监控仪表板,并添加数据推送器。推送器每 60 秒把数据库中的会话、用户、token 用量等以 JSON 发给本地仪表板,每 2 秒推送日志。仪表板网页显示这些信息。
howto.when: 当你说要“给 NanoClaw 添加一个监控仪表板”时触发。

say.text: 给 NanoClaw 加一个监控仪表板
say.note: Claude 会开始安装依赖、部署仪表板。

say.text: 帮我在 NanoClaw 上装仪表板,显示 token 用量和会话
say.note: Claude 会完成安装、配置环境变量并启动服务。

say.text: 部署本地监控面板,实时显示日志和消息活动
say.note: Claude 会添加推送器并打开仪表板页面。

howto.what_en: Claude installs a monitoring dashboard for NanoClaw and adds a data pusher. The pusher sends database info (sessions, users, token usage, etc.) as JSON every 60 seconds, and forwards log lines every 2 seconds. The dashboard web page displays the data.
howto.when_en: When you ask to add a monitoring dashboard to NanoClaw.

say_en.text: Add a monitoring dashboard to NanoClaw.
say_en.note: Claude installs the package and wires up the pusher.

say_en.text: Set up a dashboard for NanoClaw showing sessions and token usage.
say_en.note: Claude completes setup, configures env vars, and restarts.

say_en.text: Deploy a local monitoring panel with live logs and message activity.
say_en.note: Claude adds the data pusher and launches the dashboard.
